# Happimess

> Happimess is a New York City–based home organization brand founded in 2020. We design and curate trash cans, storage baskets, laundry hampers, kitchen accessories, and cleaning wipes that balance function with aesthetics. Every product undergoes a minimum 30-day evaluation — including 500+ open/close cycles for pedal and sensor mechanisms — before we add it to our catalog. We ship to the 48 contiguous United States.

## Store

- [All Products](https://happimess.com/collections/all): Browse the complete Happimess product catalog
- [Trash Cans & Waste Bins](https://happimess.com/collections/trash): Step trash cans, sensor trash cans, dual-compartment bins, waste baskets, and indoor/outdoor trash cans
- [Trash Bags & Liners](https://happimess.com/collections/trash-bags): Drawstring, scented, and unscented trash can liners in 4-gallon to 13-gallon sizes
- [Organization — Bins, Baskets & Cubes](https://happimess.com/collections/organization): Bins, baskets, storage cubes, trays, carts, hampers, and under-bed storage
- [Storage Furniture](https://happimess.com/collections/storage-furniture): Storage trunks, ottomans, benches, shelving units, and outdoor storage
- [Kitchen & Bathroom Accessories](https://happimess.com/collections/kitchen-bathroom): Dish racks, paper towel holders, toilet paper holders, shower shelves, pantry organizers
- [Wipes](https://happimess.com/collections/wipes): Heavy Duty, Mini, Plant, and Kitchen Hero cleaning wipes
